parts.text: Impute missing packet lengths in a single bidirectional network flow. The input array is chronological. Positive and negative denote opposite directions, magnitude is IP length in bytes (clipped at 1600). Each null is one missing packet. Return JSON only: an object with key values containing one nonzero signed integer in [-1600,1600] per null, in left-to-right order. Preserve the number of missing slots. Use the signs and magnitudes on both sides of each gap, repeated signed lengths, and alternating or same-direction runs to resolve ambiguous slots. Summary fields list the most frequent signed lengths and counts, the number of visible packets of each sign, and observed adjacent same-sign and sign-changing pairs. Adjacency counts skip gaps.
